2610.11585.title: Adapting English Quality Classifiers for Multilingual LLM Pretraining Data Selection
2610.11585.paper_summary: Recent advances in large language model (LLM) pretraining highlight the role of high-quality training data in improving performance. While model-based filtering has proven effective in selecting high-quality subsets from web-scale corpora, especially for high-resource languages, low-resource languages face challenges due to limited availability of annotated data. This work explores extending quality filtering to over 100 languages by proposing a multilingual adaptation approach that converts an existing English quality classifier into a multilingual variant. Our approach proposes training a small multi-layer perceptron on top of Transformer encoder-only model embeddings, using multilingual text as input and scores obtained from English classifiers applied to machine-translated text as labels. Our 1B, 3B and 8B scale experiments show that our approach maintains the downstream LLM benchmark performance of existing multilingual model-based filtering baselines, without harming regional and cultural knowledge benchmarks. To further evaluate cross-lingual generalization, we compare classifier scores of high-quality synthetic data and web samples, and the correlation of classifier scores with LLM-based ones, revealing that the classifier can learn the scoring criteria of its original English variant, even for languages not included in its training data.
2610.11585.paper_summary_zh: 最近在大型語言模型（LLM）預訓練方面的進展突顯了高品質訓練數據在提升性能中的重要性。雖然基於模型的過濾在從網絡規模語料庫中選擇高品質子集方面已被證明是有效的，特別是對於高資源語言，但低資源語言因為標註數據的可用性有限而面臨挑戰。本研究探討了通過提出一種多語言適應方法將質量過濾擴展到超過100種語言，該方法將現有的英語質量分類器轉換為多語言變體。我們的方法提出在Transformer編碼器模型嵌入的基礎上訓練一個小型多層感知器，使用多語言文本作為輸入，並將從應用於機器翻譯文本的英語分類器獲得的分數作為標籤。我們的1B、3B和8B規模實驗顯示，我們的方法在不損害區域和文化知識基準的情況下，保持了現有多語言模型基於過濾的下游LLM基準性能。為了進一步評估跨語言的泛化能力，我們比較了高品質合成數據和網絡樣本的分類器分數，以及分類器分數與基於LLM的分數的相關性，揭示了分類器能夠學習其原始英語變體的評分標準，即使對於未包含在其訓練數據中的語言。
